verdict.rationale: Bevy is explicitly "just a normal Rust dependency" (bevy-docs-21) built via standard `cargo build`, which is inherently command-line/headless and requires no editor GUI — reinforced by the probe noting 'the code-first cargo workflow needs no editor for an agent to drive' (bevy-probe-rt-2). However, there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated CI/export pipeline, asset packaging for platform export, or headless test/build examples for CI systems — missing for 10: documented CI workflow examples, cross-platform export/packaging commands, headless test-runner guidance.
